title: 6 Benefits of Glycerin for Skin
summary: Glycerin is a powerful humectant that hydrates skin effectively. Learn its benefits and how to use it in your routine.
body_markdown:
## What Skin Types Should Use Glycerin?


If you have sensitive or particular skin, you may wonder if it’s safe for you to incorporate a glycerin product into your skincare routine. The answer is likely yes.


Glycerin is highly tolerable for almost all skin types. In fact, there are zero known side effects of glycerin in skincare. However, that doesn’t mean glycerin can’t suit certain skin types more than others. The moisturizing and soothing properties of glycerin make it highly suitable for dry and sensitive skin types. On the other hand, it doesn’t hurt to try this hydrating ingredient, regardless of skin type, given its incredible benefits.


## How to Bring Glycerin into Your Skincare Routine


Ready to harness the glow-boosting powers of glycerin? Fortunately, there’s more than one way to incorporate this special ingredient into your skincare routine.


Glycerin is a common and affordable ingredient in skincare, so it’s not hard to find. Depending on your moisture needs and skin type, you could incorporate a number of products with glycerin into your routine, such as:


- **Cleanser** – Yes, even your cleanser can be hydrating. A[facial cleanser](https://www.provenskincare.com/personalized-face-cleanser/) with glycerin will prevent that “squeaky rubber” feeling that comes from stripping your skin’s natural oils. Look for a cleanser with glycerin to keep your face calm and moisturized while cleansing.
- **Toner** – For an extra dose of hydration, consider a glycerin-based toner. After cleansing, reach for a toner that features glycerin and apply it gently to the face with cotton pads.
- **Moisturizer** – The most common place you’ll find glycerin is in moisturizer formulas. The thick nature of glycerin makes it a go-to for moisturizers, imbuing the skincare product with that silky yet rich feeling. For daytime protection, seek a[daily moisturizer with SPF](https://www.provenskincare.com/personalized-day-moisturizer/) and glycerin. This will allow you to draw in hydration and boost your skin barrier to further protect your skin from the sun’s harmful UV rays.
- **Face mask** – Sometimes, your skin needs a reboot after irritation, dryness, or stress. A glycerin-based face mask has the intensive hydrating properties you need to restore balance and moisture to your skin. Consider applying a mask with glycerin at least once per week to keep your skin feeling fresh and moisturized.
